map.确认率和出席率差很多正常吗？: Is a big gap between confirmation and attendance rates normal?
map.常见。媒体「确认出席」后临时因突发任务缺席很普遍，因此出席率通常低于确认率。本工: Very common. Media that "confirmed attendance" often drop out because of breaking assignments, so attendance is usually below the confirmation rate. This tool tracks both separately precisely to expose that funnel - if confirmation is 40% but attendance only 20%, even confirmed outlets are unreliable and you need backups plus a livestream fallback.
map.状态能自定义吗？比如「改期」「 Pending 主编审批」？: Can I customize statuses, such as "rescheduled" or "pending editor approval"?
map.当前内置四类状态（已邀请/已确认/已出席/已拒绝）覆盖主流漏斗。若你有更细的状态: The four built-in statuses (invited/confirmed/attended/declined) cover the mainstream funnel. If you need finer states (such as pending approval or rescheduled), extend the status enum in your data; this tool counts by enum value, so the summary keeps working after extension.
